text: {"name":"lll_get_dev_entry","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Refreshes the selected device's connection and channel-state metadata, clears its state counters, and invokes the shared-memory copy helper.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v1":"device_table_base","v4":"connection_state_flags","v5":"device_index","v7":"channel_entry_node","v8":"channel_state_table","v9":"channel_index","v11":"channel_state_value","v12":"secondary_channel_state"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"First state counter, thresholded into a connection-state flag and then cleared."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Second state counter, thresholded into a connection-state flag and then cleared."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Device index selecting a 1320-byte connection record."},{"offset":29,"meaning":"Cached connection-state flags."},{"offset":31,"meaning":"Flag gating state refresh and then indicating whether the selected record matches the active record."},{"offset":72,"meaning":"Connection-record identity compared with the global active-record identity."},{"offset":240,"meaning":"Head pointer for the connection record's linked channel-entry list."},{"offset":35,"meaning":"Linked-node channel index used to select a channel-state row."}]}
